title: LumenHealth kickoff: propose windows, host owners, and dial-in
text:
LumenHealth kickoff: propose windows, host owners, and dial-in

['From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed kickoff windows, host owners, and dial-in

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for confirming LumenHealth is ready to kick off the implementation next week. To make scheduling quick, below are three proposed 90-minute windows (we’ll include the technical check + walkthrough + next steps):

- Option A: Tue Jul 8, 10:00–11:30 PT / 13:00–14:30 ET
- Option B: Wed Jul 9, 15:00–16:30 PT / 18:00–19:30 ET
- Option C: Thu Jul 10, 08:00–09:30 PT / 11:00–12:30 ET (early APAC-friendly)

Proposed agenda (attached: LumenHealth_kickstart_agenda_v1.pdf):
1) Welcome, introductions (10m)
2) Goals & success metrics (10m)
3) Network, security, access checklist (15m)
4) Technical architecture & service account walkthrough (25m)
5) Data handling and privacy expectations (10m)
6) Next steps, owners, and action items (20m)

Internal host matrix (attached: host_matrix.xlsx):
- Logan Wright — Implementation lead (overall kickoff facilitator)
- Monica Patel — Technical owner (service account, VPC, test harness)
- Jonas Weber — Success manager (post-kickoff cadence and health checks)

Please let us know which option works best and who from your side will join (names + roles). If none of these windows fit, share two alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Also: we can run a 20-minute tech preflight the business day before if your infra team wants to validate network access.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this underway.

Best,
Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: LumenHealth_kickstart_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF, 1 page), host_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 1 sheet)
', 'From: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@lumenhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Keith Brown <keith.brown@lumenhealth.com>, devops@lumenhealth.com
Date: 2025-07-01T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed kickoff windows, host owners, and dial-in

Hi Logan —

Thanks — Option B (Wed Jul 9, 15:00 PT) works best for our core team. Attendees from LumenHealth:
- Sarah Mills — Program Manager (me)
- Keith Brown — Engineering Manager (makes decisions on infra)
- Priya Shah — DevOps lead (devops@lumenhealth.com)
- Mark R. — Security reviewer (sending separately)

We’d like a brief 20-minute preflight with Monica on Tue Jul 8 in the morning PT to validate network and service-account access — can you suggest a time?

Also quick Q: for the architecture section, can you confirm whether we should prepare a short network diagram or will your team bring one? We can draft one if helpful.

Regards,
Sarah
Program Manager
LumenHealth
', 'From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@lumenhealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-01T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed kickoff windows, host owners, and dial-in

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround, Sarah. Wed Jul 9 at 15:00 PT is locked from our side.

Preflight suggestion: Tue Jul 8, 09:00–09:20 PT with Priya and Keith if that works. Monica will be on the call to run through the connectivity checklist: ports, IP allowlist, service account scopes, and sample request from a test host.

Calendar invite (live): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcdef123456
Primary video bridge: https://zoom.us/j/987654321 (Passcode: RedwoodKick)
Dial-in: +1 415 555 0130 (US Toll) — Meeting ID 987 654 321

Updated attendee roster (internal + external):
- Logan Wright (Redwood) — Implementation lead
- Monica Patel (Redwood) — Technical owner
- Jonas Weber (Redwood) — Customer success
- Sarah Mills (LumenHealth) — Program Manager
- Keith Brown (LumenHealth) — Eng Manager
- Priya Shah (LumenHealth) — DevOps Lead
- Mark Rivera (LumenHealth) — Security (invited)

Action items before kickoff:
- LumenHealth: share network diagram or allowlist IPs (Sarah / Priya) — due Jul 8 EOD PT
- Redwood: share sample service-account role and minimal permission set (Monica) — due Jul 7 EOD PT

I’ve attached a one-page preflight checklist (copied into the invite notes).

Best,
Monica

Attachment referenced inline: preflight-checklist.docx (DOCX, 1 page)
', 'From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@lumenhealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed kickoff windows, host owners, and dial-in

Thanks all — I’ve added the invite to our shared ops calendar and set reminders for 48h and 1h. Sarah, I added Mark Rivera to the invite as requested (email used: mark.rivera@lumenhealth.com).

Quick note for LumenHealth: after the kickoff we typically schedule a 30-day health-check call — I’ll propose a tentative slot in the invite that you can accept/modify.

See you on Jul 9.

— Jonas
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
']
